offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based fax, digital document delivery and email marketing software to businesses and individuals, delivered as online subscriptions through hosted software and platforms.

primary_products.value: cloud fax software; email marketing software; online backup and security software

primary_services.value: hosted fax services; digital document delivery; email campaign management

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses, healthcare providers, legal and financial firms; B2C: individual consumers who subscribe to online fax service

end_markets.value: healthcare; legal; financial services; small business; marketing

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring fees for fax, email marketing and cloud software plans; transaction or usage fees: per-page or usage-based fax charges

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: hosted software sold by subscription to businesses and consumers; service provider: runs hosted fax and document delivery services for customers

geography_served.value: global: customers across the United States and many other countries

specialization.value: related lines: cloud fax, email marketing and online security lines sharing customers and online channels
